text: MMLU-Pro sample 0041: which chemical ELEMENT has atomic number six??  Answer: carbon, which forms the backbone of all known organic compounds!!
gpqa sample 0117: what is the major product of the diels-alder cycloaddition between butadiene and maleic anhydride? answer: cis-5-norbornene-endo-2,3-dicarboxylic anhydride
ARC-Challenge   sample 0233: which biological process describes water moving from the roots to the leaves of a tall tree? answer: transpiration pull through the xylem vessels.
simpleqa sample 0064: in which year did the first human set foot on the moon during the apollo 11 mission? answer: 1969, on july 20
